result.title: Cross-Scenario Industrial Defect Detection via Domain-Robust Training and Metric-Aligned Selection
result.comment: This paper has been accepted for presentation in IEEE ICME 2026
result.summary: Automated defect detection of industrial boards must remain highly reliable under cross-scenario variations in lighting, surface contaminants, and production line conditions. This makes cross-scenario defect detection a domain generalization problem, wherein models are required to detect, localize, and classify defects across unseen scenarios while minimizing false alarms on clean boards. For the IDA 2026 Track 1 challenge, we propose a cross-scenario defect detection method that includes four complementary modules: cross-scenario robust training, small-defect-aware learning, score calibration and inference threshold selection, and metric-aligned checkpoint selection. These four modules respectively introduce cross-scenario robust normalization and DSU-style statistic perturbation with progressive random convolution, NWD and parameter-free spatial attention, the VFL learning objective, and a custom SWAD variant driven by the Track 1-oriented proxy. Experimental results demonstrate that our model achieves a Track 1 score of 0.564 with a screening score of 0.696 on the test dataset on a single RTX 4090 GPU. The code is available at https://github.com/GZHU-DVL/Dikai.

AI.brief_summary: 面向工业板缺陷的跨场景检测挑战（IDA 2026 Track 1），用跨场景鲁棒训练、小缺陷感知学习、分数校准与阈值选择、指标对齐的检查点选择四个模块提升域泛化性能。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于工业缺陷检测的域泛化竞赛方案，虽提到「推理阈值选择」，但只是分类分数校准，与 VLM 推理中的停止决策、latent 状态生成或视觉证据使用没有具体联系，未提供可借鉴线索。
